title: Binance Wallet Alpha Deposit Campaign: Deposit Grvt (GRVT) and Share $20K Worth of Rewards
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  Binance Wallet is excited to launch the  Binance Alpha Grvt (GRVT) Deposit Campaign ! During the Promotion Period, deposit GRVT tokens by following the campaign rules to share exclusive token rewards. This campaign is  only eligible for GRVT community airdrop users  who received the official GRVT airdrop on BNB Smart Chain (BSC). Binance Alpha Token Deposit Campaign Promotion Period: 2026-07-30 13:00 (UTC) to 2026-08-01 13:00 (UTC) General Rules​​: Participants will be ranked according to the time they complete the Deposit and Transfer task during the Promotion Period. The first  1,666  eligible users who deposit and transfer  at least 300 GRVT  in a  single transaction  will share a total reward pool of  66,640 GRVT equally  ( 40 GRVT  per user) on a  first-come, first-served  basis. This campaign is only eligible for GRVT community airdrop users. How to Participate: Deposit eligible tokens from external on-chain address to Binance Wallet (Keyless)  Select  [Binance Wallet (Keyless)]  in  [My Wallets] . Select  [Receive]  and deposit the specified amount of funds from the GRVT community airdrop receiving wallet address* to your Binance Wallet (Keyless). Transfer eligible tokens from Binance Wallet (Keyless) to Binance Alpha 2.0 Account Switch to the  [Exchange]  tab and go to  [Asset]  -  [Alpha]  to view your Binance  Alpha 2.0 Account page. Select  [Transfer In]  and transfer the specified amount of eligible tokens. Please Note: This campaign is only eligible for GRVT community airdrop users who received their airdrop on BSC. To qualify, users must complete Step 1  before  Step 2. Both steps must be completed during the Promotion Period. If you have already received the GRVT airdrop directly in your Binance Wallet (Keyless), you may skip Step 1 and proceed to Step 2 directly. Eligibility will be determined based on the completion time of Step 2. The external on-chain address used for the deposit in Step 1 must be the same address that received the GRVT community airdrop. Deposits from other addresses will  not  qualify. Rewards for the Binance Alpha Token Deposit Campaign will be distributed directly to the winning users’ Binance Alpha Accounts or Binance Wallet (Keyless) on a  first-come, first-served basis .  *GRVT airdrop receiving wallet address:  The on-chain wallet address where you received your GRVT community airdrop. You must deposit GRVT from this address directly — deposits from any other wallet address will  not  be counted as eligible. Reward Distribution: All rewards will be distributed in   GRVT tokens, according to the reward distribution mentioned above. GRVT Deposit Campaign token rewards will be distributed to eligible users before  2026-08-15 13:00 (UTC) .
